ImageDescription.value:
With my friends Jack and Don. Photo taken at night around the pool area at the Kahala Hilton Hotel, early February 1988.

This was four years after Michael's scalp was burned during the filming of a Pepsi commercial, two years after he was diagnosd with vitiligo, a skin condition, one month before he finalized the purchase of the land that would become Neverland, and four months before he began sexually molesting Jimmy Safechuck according to the documentary Leaving Neverland.

Scanned from the original 35MM film negative.
